# Driver-Server Version Compatibility Matrix

<!-- Generated by resources/generate_compatibility.py; do not edit. -->

This file is regenerated for every client release by `resources/bump_version.py`.

Supported engine versions come from the [SingleStore software EOL policy](https://docs.singlestore.com/db/latest/support/singlestore-software-end-of-life-eol-policy/). An engine is listed when it had been released and its end-of-life date was still in the future on the client release date. The [latest release-candidate index](https://release.memsql.com/rc/index/singlestoredbserver/latest.json) does not publish a start date, so the current release candidate is listed on the current client release.

Tested Python versions come from the smoke-test CI workflow at each release tag.
